title: Paloma Business Ruling: Amount a Card Deposit Fee Is Charged On
content:
For a Paloma Business debit-card deposit, the amount the card deposit rate is charged on depends on the whole months since KYB approval.

### Ruling

An account approved at least 36 whole months earlier is charged on the part of the deposit above 1000.00 USD; an account approved at least 12 and fewer than 36 whole months earlier is charged on the whole deposit, with the card deposit fee capped at 75.00 USD; every other account is charged on the whole deposit. The card deposit fee is the charged amount times the card deposit rate over 100, under the cap where this ruling sets one, never below 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent.

### Method table

| Whole months since KYB approval | Amount charged on | Cap on the fee |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | The part of the deposit above 1000.00 USD | None |
| 12 to 35 | The whole deposit | 75.00 USD |
| Fewer than 12 | The whole deposit | None |

### Worked figures (hypothetical deposit of 6000.00 USD at a card deposit rate of 2.20 percent)

| Whole months since approval | Fee |
|---|---|
| 40 | 5000.00 multiplied by 2.20 over 100: 110.00 USD |
| 20 | 6000.00 multiplied by 2.20 over 100 is 132.00, capped at 75.00 USD |
| 6 | 132.00 USD |

Further cases: a deposit of 800.00 USD on an account approved 40 whole months earlier has no part above 1000.00 USD, and the fee is 0.00. A deposit of 3000.00 USD at 2.20 percent on an account approved 20 whole months earlier gives 66.00 USD, under the cap.
